injuries.description: She has scarring on the top of the scalp running on to the forehead near the hairline, on her right ear, and a large keloidal scar on the front of the right leg, as well as scars on the right hip as a result of a bohe graft, on the knuckles of her right hand, her buttocks and her back.

injuries.description: restricted movement of her right arm, and she demonstrated that she could only raise her right arm to just above shoulder height.
source: She has restricted movement of her right arm, and she demonstrated that she could only raise her right arm to just above shoulder height.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation or strain or sprain of joints or ligaments of shoulder girdle, unspecified

manifestations.description: an appreciable loss of hearing in both ears (a 10dB loss in the left ear and a 20dB loss in the right ear).
Romberg's test was positive (patient sways with feet together and eyes closed).
weakness of the sixth right cranial nerve resulting in an inability to move the right eye to the extreme lateral position.
restricted movement of her right arm; could only raise right arm to just above shoulder height.

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation (10th March 1986)
removal of the plate from her leg (admitted 29th February 1988; discharged 18th March 1988)

losses.description: Self-consciousness about forehead scars and large keloidal scar on right leg; wears hair to mask forehead scars; feels self conscious in a dress because of the leg scar.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Used to go swimming and to the cinema; now does not like to be seen in a swim suit and seldom goes out.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Nervous of crowded places because she fears being overcome by dizziness.
Seldom goes out; no longer enjoys shopping and going to restaurants; friends and former colleagues might notice and comment on changed appearance.
She and her husband have separated, the one child of the marriage living with her husband.

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy quiet or solitude
losses.description: Cannot watch television as before because after about ten minutes she experiences double-vision.

comparable_cases.case_name: YIP Wan-chun and Jim Non-tak and Anr.
comparable_cases.injury_description: the female plaintiff sustained a cut on her left temple, her left collarbone was fractured and she became almost totally deaf. The plaintiff suffered tinnitus and giddiness.
